mapper.select: SELECT f.field_name, SUM(d.numeric_value) AS total FROM report_submissions s JOIN report_submission_data d ON d.submission_id = s.id JOIN report_template_fields f ON f.id = d.field_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT assignment_id, MAX(version) AS max_version FROM report_submissions WHERE status IN ('pending_receipt', 'received') GROUP BY assignment_id ) latest ON s.assignment_id = latest.assignment_id AND s.version = latest.max_version WHERE s.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND s.status IN ('pending_receipt', 'received') AND f.field_type = 'number' GROUP BY f.field_name

choose.otherwise: SELECT NULL AS periodLabel, NULL AS fieldName, NULL AS total WHERE 1 = 0

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM report_submissions WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND status IN ('pending_receipt', 'received')
